note: Documentation-code consistency review of the story-level integrated change for B-137a: no blocker. Step 1 extracted ~200 changed exported symbols from `git diff main...HEAD` over packages/main/src. Step 2 narrowed to the 6 changed doc files and compared only the paragraphs referencing those symbols: docs/host-run-usage.md (substantially rewritten), the new docs/requirements/decisions/managed-cross-provider-cli-execution.md, docs/CLI.md, multi-host-keyword-candidate-spec-routing-execution-plan.md, session-ownership-and-write-leases.md, tier-c-crosshost-quorum-execution-plan.md. Step 3 verified each promise against code. Findings: zero inconsistencies. Verified numeric constants all match managed-host-run.ts:71-77 — 30s status wait cap (MANAGED_HOST_RUN_STATUS_WAIT_MAX_MS, also enforced as z.max(30000) at command-catalog.ts:3094), 30-minute default and 24-hour maximum absolute deadline, 8 MiB per-run output retention, 90-day terminal retention; docs/CLI.md's new 270-second evidence default matches DEFAULT_VALIDATE_COMMAND_TIMEOUT_MS=270_000 (validation-executor.ts:42) and validate.evidenceCommandTimeoutOverrides exists at config.ts:233 and is consumed at validation-executor.ts:661-663. Slot path .lattice/runtime/provider-process-slots/ matches provider-process-registry.ts:30 with zero residue of the retired .lattice/usage/host-run-slots/. The five ProviderExecutionSurfaceStatus values in both the host-run-usage.md list and the decision-record table match the union at provider-process-registry.ts:395-400 exactly, including the docs' specific claim that legacy_unmanaged is reserved and currently empty by contract, which is mechanically asserted at provider-execution-inventory-contract.ts:45, and the docs' explicit note that no admission_managed status exists. The import precondition triple promised by host-run-usage.md, the decision record and session-ownership-and-write-leases.md (replacementSafe=true + processCleanup.reaped=true + processCleanup.residualProcessGroup=false) is real at managed-review-evidence.ts:324-326. agy retirement is honest rather than overclaimed: host_run refuses agy pre-spawn with an argv-transport reason at host-run.ts:1630-1635, and agy plus --agyPrintTimeout are genuinely absent from the public host_run schema at command-catalog.ts:3074-3089, matching the doc sentence that agy 'is absent from that command's public schema' and remains diagnostic-only (host_runtime_list/host_runtime_probe at command-catalog.ts:1393-1398 are the surviving diagnostic surfaces). Native broker promises in host-run-usage.md and session-ownership-and-write-leases.md are delivered: nativeReviewInvocation.brokers with brokerId/adapterId/host/publicKey at config.ts:177-185, Ed25519 verification via verifyCanonical from authority-signing.ts at native-review-attestation.ts:6-10,117, and atomic one-shot nonce burn at :161-183. The two subtler ancestry claims also hold: an unavailable ps view returns null rather than rejecting a valid attestation (native-review-evidence.ts:103-107) while any observable mixed provider family vetoes (:112-115, mixedProviderFamilies). doctor --full per-run detail (state, worker liveness, heartbeat, providerProgressMode, deadline, cancel, residual, replacementSafe, retention) is delivered at doctor.ts:75-105 and the docs' --full framing is correct because doctor is brief-by-default at the CLI seam (cli-engine.ts:502-505, 894-897). dispatch's documented two explicit execution modes are emitted at story-dispatch.ts:178-180. host_run_status/host_run_cancel/host_run_worker (internal visibility) and managed_review_evidence_import (runId+receiptId only, no verdict override) all match command-catalog.ts:3090-3130, as does managed_review_proposal_set being labeled compatibility-only. Mandatory docs-to-code reverse scan for promised-but-undelivered: every lattice command, flag and field newly named in the changed docs resolves to real registered handler/core code; no doc-promise-undelivered case found. One deliberate non-finding recorded for transparency: the agy usage-recording branch at host-run.ts:2217-2236 is now unreachable dead code because the pre-spawn refusal at :1630 precedes it, but the docs correctly stopped documenting agy usage parsing, so this is a code-quality matter for another lane and not docs-code drift. Fallback 2 note: no symbol required README-window fallback; all compared symbols had either direct doc references or were verified as intentionally undocumented internals. Canonical reports read and reported honestly, not treated as gate evidence and not upgraded: acceptance_topology_check status=inconclusive blocking=false mode=observe authority=diagnostic_only (AT_UNMAPPED_SCOPE_REF, AT_MISSING_TOPOLOGY); pre_review_check_read status=inconclusive ok=false blocking=false mode=observe authority=inadmissible (PR_ARTIFACT_TAMPERED plus 12 further PR_* codes); acceptance_rollout_report_read status=fail ok=false blocking=false mode=observe receipt=stale quorum=full-3x2; acceptance_rollout_check status=fail ok=false blocking=false mode=observe receipt=stale quorum=full-3x2. All four are non-PASS in observe mode with blocking=false and this work makes no promotion claim, so under the stated policy they are advisory only for this lane; no topology is fabricated and no degraded 3x1 is accepted. Environment note: the lattice binary is not on PATH in this provider environment, so the four reports were run via node bin/lattice.js.
